intro.text: The king of Relu-na, a greatshell island in the Reshi Sea, and a Dustbringer.

items.text: When Ral-na was young, Vstim visited Relu-na and won the people's respect by killing a coracot. In time Ral-na and his partner sent their son Talik to train under Vstim in Thaylenah.

Around 1173, Vstim brought Rysn to Relu-na to negotiate a trade deal as a test, with Talik as intermediary. Impressed by her fierce arguments, Ral-na let her address him directly, but refused the deal, as she hadn't earned the respect Vstim had. Rysn climbed down a feeding rope to appeal to Relu-na itself; Ral-na ordered her back, but the rope broke and she fell.

After Rysn's visit, Ral-na bonded an ashspren by saying the First Ideal, and his body healed to match his gender. About two years after Rysn's visit, he travelled with a Reshi delegation to meet Dalinar in Urithiru, partly to learn more about his bond and the Knights Radiant.

appearance.text: He has dark eyes and greying hair, and favours voluminous, brightly coloured robes. Since his bond he is a short man with a strong chest.

personality.text: Usually soft-spoken in front of outsiders, he seems calm but can be forceful when needed.
